inShort: B starts at the baseline and may move up to the kitchen only after 2 clean resets in a row. A plays from the kitchen line.
rules: A stands at the kitchen line, B at the baseline.
B plays a drop and moves into the transition zone, not yet all the way in.
A answers with balls at B's feet. B resets each one into the kitchen.
After 2 clean resets in a row, B may step up to the kitchen line. A reset that sits up: B stays back.
B scores a point by reaching the kitchen line. A scores a point when a reset misses or sits up. First to 5, then swap roles.
tooEasy: A plays real pressure at the feet, with topspin and changing pace. Even harder: B needs 3 clean resets before moving up.
goodLooksLike: B moves up only after a good reset, and the resets drop low into the kitchen.
